title: Claude Code Waits Out Your Usage Limit
caption:
My usage limit used to be where the run died.

2.1.234 continues the session on its own when the claude.ai limit resets. Three more changes shipped the same week — /goal checks in when background work parks it, and an idle session now reports back by itself.

Honest admission: I still sit there and watch it go. Not sure I trust an unattended run yet.

Do you walk away?

slides.headline:
Limit resets.
Run continues.
slides.sub: Claude Code 2.1.234 now continues your session automatically when a claude.ai usage limit resets. Published to npm August 17.

slides.title: Four changes, one week
items: Aug 12 — remote-control --continue resumes your last session
Aug 17 — the session continues itself when the claude.ai limit resets
Aug 17 — /goal checks in when background work parks it 30+ minutes
Aug 19 — an idle session parked behind background work checks in
